lead.headline: Allgeier split the work with his own backup — and AVIATO still lead by 39.9
lead.deck: Every starter is locked. Bok-aneers need about 40 from Kraft and Lloyd tonight; ESPN gives AVIATO 99%.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Tyler Allgeier, started on the projection with Jeremiyah Love out, has 4.7 late in Arizona's game, and Bam Knight has taken 14 touches to his 15; Alvin Kamara scored 14.9 on your bench. Josh Allen had 10 at the half in a 13-13 game. It will not cost the week: Bhayshul Tuten (24.7), Isaiah Likely (23.9) and Jalen Coker (15.7 on 13 targets) built a 113.16 to 73.24 lead, and Bok-aneers have only Tucker Kraft and MarShawn Lloyd left. What matters next is Week 7: Allen, Tuten and McLaurin are on bye, Love starts at quarterback, and the back who replaces Tuten is Tuesday's projection — with today's Arizona split now part of that question.
